description: This Dart source file defines the routing logic for a Flutter application, centralizing route names, and implementing `onGenerateRoute` to handle navigation based on route names. It includes a home placeholder screen with an auth-based navigation redirect, and defines several route placeholders for future screens such as login, register, dashboard, appointments, and records.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: A utility class that centralizes route name constants and implements the route generation logic for the app.

classes.name: _HomeGatePlaceholderScreen
classes.description: A screen that shows a placeholder while determining the user's authentication status, then redirects to either dashboard or login.

classes.name: _SimplePlaceholder
classes.description: A generic placeholder screen with a customizable title, used for unimplemented routes.

methods.name: AppRoutes._
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the utility class.

methods.name: AppRoutes.onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Factory method that returns route objects based on route name, handling known routes and default fallback.

methods.name: _HomeGatePlaceholderScreenState.initState
methods.description: Initializes the placeholder screen and schedules an immediate redirect based on authentication state.

methods.name: _SimplePlaceholder.build
methods.description: Builds a simple scaffold with a title and static 'Coming soon...' text.
